attributes.title: Level 1

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn more about using variables in your projects to store, update, and display information!

questions.hint: What is a variable used for in a computer program?
questions.title: [Select one] What is a variable?

answers.text: A sprite that has various outfits to choose from.
A code block that changes color based on its mood.
A concept that exists only in math, not coding.
A piece of data that can be stored, updated, and used in a program.

questions.correctResponse: Remember variables are like moving boxes!

questions.hint: How should you name a variable in a project?
questions.title: [Select one] Just like when labeling boxes for moving, the names of variables should ________.

answers.text: Clearly indicate what the variable is for
Be confusing and not relate to what the variable is at all
Add a little mystery to what to the variable is
Not matter and doesn’t require any logic behind it

questions.correctResponse: The names of variables should help you, not confuse you, on the value it stores.

questions.hint: Which data type(s) can be stored in a variable?
questions.title: [Select one] Variables can store which of the following?
questions.correctResponse: There are several different types of data you can store in a variable.

questions.hint: Is it easier to read code in a clean or messy project?
questions.title: [Select one] Using variables and having clean, organized code makes the program easier to read by both the computer and coder.
questions.correctResponse: Keeping your code clean helps you and the computer read the code, limiting the possibility of bugs!

subgroups.title: Variables!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn more about using variables in your projects to store, update, and display information!

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Yellow Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about variables, which are pieces of data that can be stored, updated, and used in your programs. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: Data Entry
badges.description: Use variables to keep track of data in a project.

badges.title: YOLO
badges.description: Set and change the lives variable in a project.

badges.title: Time Flies
badges.description: Set a countdown timer in a project.

badges.title: Keeping Track
badges.description: Set and change the score variable in a project.

badges.title: -poof-
badges.description: Destroy a sprite when something happens in a project.
